runtime.name: FadedCore runtime 0.4.3
runtime.description: FadedCore 0.4.3 adds launcher compatibility fixes for Windows DLL casing and the qualified Steam overlay's cold certificate cache, bounded redirect validation and clearer launch errors. Other runtime/gameplay payloads retain 0.4.2 bytes. Install once, then add compatible mods separately. Exact supported Windows x64 game build and .NET runtime remain required; existing gameplay/multiplayer qualification limits apply.

sdk.name: FadedCore developer SDK - RC6 (preview)
sdk.description: Authors only: frozen matching RC6 kit for runtime suite 0.4.2, including map-readiness and equipped-avatar presentation. Compiled identities remain 0.4.0. Preserve the inner feature floor minimumRuntime 0.4.0; enforce the required distribution revision through signed packageDependencies[fadedcore.suite] 0.4.2 (pack --runtime-min 0.4.2). Recompile older concrete phone-map calls against this kit. Players do not need the SDK.
sdk.licenseStatus: No first-party license grant is added; owner license selection remains required before a production SDK release.

mods.name: Gang Life
mods.description: Build your own gang or join one of ten fictional factions. Recruit specialists, establish strongholds and contest territory through the tablet headquarters, shared NPC orders, seven firearms, optional third-person, needs and 40 offline voice clips. Install FadedCore 0.4.2 first; every multiplayer peer needs matching runtime/mod packages. F5 headquarters, F4 interaction, F6 camera, F7 map overlay. Early release: connected multiplayer, ordinary firing/reload, native item persistence and audible playback remain unverified.
limitations: Matching FadedCore 0.4.2 and Gang Life 0.2.0 assets are required on every peer. Connected multiplayer has not been observed; support follows the accepted assumed-working/reactive-fix policy.
Ordinary firing/reload, raised grip/muzzle calibration, native item save/reload and audible/positional playback remain unqualified; no manual gameplay gate is imposed.

Four pistol/SMG/rifle definitions use native semiautomatic action; three shotgun definitions use a native pump controller. Automatic fire, a distinct break action and native bat melee are not implemented.
KSG capacity is one effective 14-shell pool without independently selectable tubes.
No measured performance improvement or universal AI arbitration is claimed.
Runtime works with installer 0.3.20. Installer 0.3.21 adds independent publisher-signed helper updates; compatible framework/mod/helper releases then use this catalog.

The RC6 binaries implement host-authoritative owned NPC replication, map readiness and equipped-avatar presentation. Local RC6 tablet/map/held-model/camera observations are recorded; no connected multiplayer session qualifies these binaries. Every peer needs the matching runtime and authenticated mod assets.
Online badge describes local runtime readiness, not a multiplayer connection.
Ordinary registered-item firing/reload, raised grip/muzzle calibration, native item save/reload, audible playback and remaining teardown/needs/camera boundaries remain unqualified.
Comparative performance remains partial; SDK remains developer preview with no added first-party license grant.
Runtime updates preserve installed mod selections; bundled acceptance examples are disabled and do not activate automatically.
